gaps: P0: no candidates. P2: only a small dark painting of the castle (#10, about 1700, 1000 px) and a tiny 1726 book print (#9); both too weak. The 1581 and 1753 views are each within 100 years of the late 17th century.
notes: #3: dated 1581 as B&H vol. 3 (BM gives 1574–94). #7 (1645 issue, 6502 px, paler coloring) is a higher-resolution alternative. #15: Sandby’s print published by Sayer and Overton; Rijksmuseum dates it 1753. #18 is the same print as #17; #20/#24 (Edinburgh from the castle, a general view without the castle itself) are the alternative for P4. #12 is Guardi’s Piazza San Marco, Venice (excluded); #11 is the 1824 fire (event, not used). #14 (Barker’s 1789–90 panorama from Calton Hill) is an uncolored partial set. P6: no single-frame photograph of the center among the candidates; #29 is a very wide panorama, so the popup shows about a quarter of it.
